brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Israel's political system faces fundamental challenges to democratic governance regardless of whether Gadi Eisenkot or Benjamin Netanyahu leads the next government. The outlet's analysis suggests that years of military expansion and collective desire for vengeance have stripped away liberal institutions and safeguards.

The assessment reflects deepening concerns about Israel's political trajectory and the durability of democratic processes amid ongoing regional conflict and internal polarization.

title: Israeli democracy compromised regardless of coalition outcome, analyst says
